notes: Spine (20): gap on the mechanism of zincophilic sites -> C HS model host -> carbonisation -> Zn plating -> single-atom/cluster/network deposition sequence (n5, F1d) -> initial nucleation sites govern deposition and performance (n20) -> the three coexisting Zn forms (n6) -> hypothesis that zincophilic sites control the nuclei distribution -> DFT screen (DES/method, headline) -> Zn binding turns exothermic on N-doped graphene (PRP) -> down_select of CnC HS with C HS control -> polydopamine-derived N shell -> N in the shell -> Zn-N bonds at pyridinic N -> pyridinic N identified as the active site (MEC/identification) -> planar vs dendritic deposit -> spacious-vs-dense nucleation MEC (F3f/g) -> lower overpotential -> cycling capability -> conclusion. Off-spine claims: s1 metallic Zn identity (F1a, F1c), s2 hollow-sphere host (F2e), s3 even N distribution through the shell (F2f), sN substitutional N charge state (F2a, basis imposed), and n18, the Zn-MnO2 full cell and phone demonstration, which the judge moved off the spine as an applied demonstration (n17 is the performance claim the conclusion uses). Audits (3): a1 the circled single atoms in the 1 nm F1c sub-image are at the noise level (qualifies n6); a2 the ~1200 cm-1 Raman feature is inside the noise band in all four F3c traces (qualifies n12); a3 the two CE records in F4a span ~50 vs ~205 cycles so the quoted averages cover unequal ranges (qualifies n17). Panel citation dropped for F2d: its crop carries OCR cue class 'XPS' from the 'Binding Energy (eV)' axis label, incompatible with ATOM:DFT; o7 cites figs ['F2'] with attrs.fig_ref 'F2d' and the technique was not changed. Figure/text and figure-internal mismatches recorded in image_note: F4c sub-panels labelled '0.5/2.0/4.0 mA h cm-2' where caption and text say current densities in mA cm-2; F4b first large spikes at ~2600-3000 min against the text's 3000/4000 min; F4f capacity axis extends to -2.0 mAh; F2a colour bar (0-0.6) cannot show the quoted -1.1741 e Bader charge; F3c x-axis last tick is 1650 cm-1 (packet OCR: 1850); F4d in-plot strings '39mV'/'43mV' are missing from the packet's annotations list. Not in the graph: all SI-only content (Figures S1-S21, XPS Fig S8b, CV Fig S17, the C HS full-cell control Fig S21), and the initial Coulombic efficiencies (77% vs 85%), which are text-only.
